Executive Simulator · FinOps of AI

Operation Cognitive Capital

An interactive simulator that teaches by discovery the real economy of Artificial Intelligence in companies: Why the most expensive AI no is the one that charges most for use — and how to measure what She really delivers.

You don't need to know anything about AI in the first place. Each screen has purpose, step by step and a glossary in simple language.

The central idea

When a company adopts AI, it sees only the tip of the iceberg: the usage invoice (the API). But the real cost is dominated by what is submerged — the human hours spends reviewing and correcting what the AI has produced, infrastructure and governance.

In large business software pipelines, the API is usually less than 10% of total cost. Who optimizes only the price of the token is discussing the wrong part of the problem. The simulator It leads you to rediscover that -- and invent the metric that corrects the error.

What you come out knowing

  • 📊 Read the total cost (TCO) of an AI operation — not just the API invoice.
  • 🧭 Use UI/$ (Useful Intelligence per Dollar) to compare architectural decisions.
  • 🧠 See human cost nonlinear: the fatigue of checking wrong AI (V core).
  • ⚖️ Defend Choices with evidence — including in regulated sectors (Governed UI/$).
